aligned_read_bases.denominator: Count of aligned query bases in primary records.
aligned_read_bases.description: Primary mapped nucleotide bases represented by CIGAR M, =, or X. Excludes soft clips, insertions, and hard clips.
aligned_read_bases.label: Aligned primary-read bases

average_read_depth.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: coverage per genome_coverage.csv row. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.

clipped_read_fraction.denominator: Soft-clipped primary reads / all mapped primary reads.
clipped_read_fraction.description: Fraction of primary mapped read alignments carrying one or more soft clips, counting each mapped primary record once.
clipped_read_fraction.label: Fraction of mapped reads clipped

deleted_reference_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR D reference bases.

deleted_reference_bases.label: Mapped reference deletion bases

duplicates.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.

duplicates.label: Primary duplicate alignments

exact_coverage_breadth_ge_1.denominator: Bases in the selected longest final MAX consensus; read placements are not unique molecules or approximate mapper alignments.

final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.description: Proportion of assembled 31-mer instances repeated in other contigs. A heuristic indicator of redundancy, not misassembly.
final_contig_31mer_redundancy_fraction.label: Redundant contig 31-mer fraction

final_contig_count.description: Number of assembled contigs passed to downstream MiCall processing. Neither more nor fewer alone proves correctness.
final_contig_count.label: Final contig count

final_contig_exact_duplicates.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: repeated exact final sequences; redundant mapping hypotheses. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
final_contig_exact_duplicates.description: Final contig exact duplicates: repeated exact final sequences; redundant mapping hypotheses. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
final_contig_exact_duplicates.label: Final contig exact duplicates

final_contig_total_bases.denominator: Sum of assembled contig sequence lengths.
final_contig_total_bases.description: Sum of lengths of all final assembled contigs. Overlapping and duplicate segments are counted repeatedly.
final_contig_total_bases.label: Total contig bases

final_contig_unknown_count.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: final contig rows classified as unknown; runtime burden proxy. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
final_contig_unknown_count.description: Final contig unknown count: final contig rows classified as unknown; runtime burden proxy. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
final_contig_unknown_count.label: Final contig unknown count

inserted_bases.denominator: Count of CIGAR I query bases.
inserted_bases.description: Nucleotide insertions in primary read alignments, from CIGAR I. True biological indels cannot be classified as errors from this alone.
inserted_bases.label: Mapped primary-read insertion bases

left_clip_events.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
left_clip_events.description: Primary mapped CIGAR soft clips at the left read end. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
left_clip_events.label: Left soft-clip events

left_clipped_bases.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
left_clipped_bases.description: Query bases removed by left-end CIGAR S operations. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
left_clipped_bases.label: Left soft-clipped bases

mapped_fragments.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: distinct mapped QNAME pairs. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
mapped_fragments.description: Mapped fragments: distinct mapped QNAME pairs. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
mapped_fragments.label: Mapped fragments

mapq_unknown.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
mapq_unknown.description: Primary mapped SAM alignments with mapping quality 255. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
mapq_unknown.label: Primary reads with unknown MAPQ

mapq_zero.denominator: Count of mapped primary records with MAPQ 0.
mapq_zero.description: Mapped primary reads assigned MAPQ 0, which indicates no mapping confidence on the SAM scale.
mapq_zero.label: Primary reads with MAPQ 0

mean_known_mapq.denominator: Sum of known primary MAPQ / primary records with MAPQ != 255.
mean_known_mapq.description: Mean mapping quality among mapped primary alignment records with known MAPQ. SAM MAPQ 255 denotes unknown and is excluded.
mean_known_mapq.label: Mean known MAPQ

mean_soft_clip_event_length.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
mean_soft_clip_event_length.description: Mean number of clipped query bases per primary CIGAR S event. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
mean_soft_clip_event_length.label: Mean soft-clip event length

multimap_avg_depth_mean.label: Multimap avg depth mean

multimap_avg_depth_total.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: sum of Q15 fractional depth across contig positions. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.

multimap_max_depth_mean.description: Multimap max depth mean: mean Q15 maximum depth across contig positions. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
multimap_max_depth_mean.label: Multimap max depth mean

multimap_max_depth_total.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: sum of Q15 maximum depth across contig positions. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
multimap_max_depth_total.description: Multimap max depth total: sum of Q15 maximum depth across contig positions. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
multimap_max_depth_total.label: Multimap max depth total

multimap_oversized_pairs.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: pairs omitted by SAM record group size limit. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
multimap_oversized_pairs.description: Multimap oversized pairs: pairs omitted by SAM record group size limit. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
multimap_oversized_pairs.label: Multimap oversized pairs

nuc_q15_covered_fraction.description: Fraction of expected positions with supported Q15 nucleotide coverage, as available in MiCall's nucleotide summary.
nuc_q15_covered_fraction.label: Q15 breadth

nuc_q15_mean_depth.denominator: Mean depth over represented Q15 nucleotide positions.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.description: Average nucleotide read depth among the positions represented in MiCall's quality-cutoff-15 nucleotide summary.
nuc_q15_mean_depth.label: Mean Q15 depth

nuc_q15_positions_covered.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: Q15 positions with depth above zero across deduplicated seeds. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
nuc_q15_positions_covered.description: Nuc Q15 positions covered: Q15 positions with depth above zero across deduplicated seeds. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
nuc_q15_positions_covered.label: Nuc Q15 positions covered

nuc_q15_total_depth.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: sum of Q15 depth across deduplicated (seed,reference position). No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
nuc_q15_total_depth.description: Nuc Q15 total depth: sum of Q15 depth across deduplicated (seed,reference position). Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
nuc_q15_total_depth.label: Nuc Q15 total depth

nuc_soft_clips_count.denominator: Sum or deduplicated per-position nuc.csv clip aggregate.
nuc_soft_clips_count.description: MiCall's aggregated per-position nuc.csv clip count. This quantity has different inclusion and duplication rules than SAM soft clips.
nuc_soft_clips_count.label: MiCall per-position clip aggregate

primary_mapped.denominator: Count of primary mapped alignment records.
primary_mapped.description: Primary alignment records marked mapped in the SAM. Secondary and supplementary records are excluded; records need not be unique molecules.
primary_mapped.label: Primary mapped reads

primary_mapped_fraction.description: Fraction of primary SAM alignment records marked mapped; this is a read-record rate, not a genome reconstruction score.
primary_mapped_fraction.label: Primary mapped read fraction

primary_unmapped.denominator: Count of primary unmapped alignment records.
primary_unmapped.description: Primary alignment records carrying the SAM unmapped flag. Not the same as a count of unmatched original read pairs.
primary_unmapped.label: Primary unmapped reads

read_bases.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
read_bases.description: Query sequence bases in primary mapped SAM alignments. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
read_bases.label: Primary mapped sequenced bases

records.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
records.description: All mapped, unmapped, secondary and supplementary SAM records. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
records.label: SAM alignment records

reference_bases_ge_100.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: genome_coverage.csv rows with coverage >=100. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
reference_bases_ge_100.description: Reference bases ge 100: genome_coverage.csv rows with coverage >=100. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
reference_bases_ge_100.label: Reference bases ge 100

region_concordance_covered_mean.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: unweighted pct_concordance where pct_covered > 0. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
region_concordance_covered_mean.description: Region concordance covered mean: unweighted pct_concordance where pct_covered > 0. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
region_concordance_covered_mean.label: Region concordance covered mean

region_concordance_mean.denominator: Mean of valid region concordance percentages.
region_concordance_mean.description: Mean MiCall regional concordance between the final result and the aligned reference panel, evaluated only after assembly.
region_concordance_mean.label: Mean region concordance

right_clip_events.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
right_clip_events.description: Primary mapped CIGAR soft clips at the right read end. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
right_clip_events.label: Right soft-clip events

right_clipped_bases.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
right_clipped_bases.description: Query bases removed by right-end CIGAR S operations. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
right_clipped_bases.label: Right soft-clipped bases

secondary.denominator: Count of SAM secondary alignment records.
secondary.description: SAM secondary alignments, including alternative placements. A large count can reflect legitimate multi-mapping rather than errors.
secondary.label: Secondary alignments

soft_clip_events.denominator: Count; per 1,000 mapped primary reads is available separately.
soft_clip_events.description: CIGAR S operations on primary mapped reads. One read can contribute a left and right clip event.
soft_clip_events.label: Soft-clip events

soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.description: Frequency of individual left/right CIGAR S clipping operations among mapped primary alignment records.
soft_clip_events_per_1000_primary_mapped.label: Clip events per 1,000 mapped reads

soft_clip_length_max.denominator: Original primary aligned SAM records; counts are alignments, not unique molecules.
soft_clip_length_max.description: Maximum CIGAR S operation length on primary mapped reads. This is a primary-alignment record statistic from the actual MiCall SAM CIGAR output.
soft_clip_length_max.label: Longest soft-clip event

soft_clipped_bases.denominator: Count; normalized per 1,000 mapped sequenced bases separately.
soft_clipped_bases.description: Total nucleotide bases excluded by CIGAR S operations on primary mapped alignment records.
soft_clipped_bases.label: Soft-clipped bases

soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.description: Total soft-clipped nucleotides normalized by mapped primary-read sequence bases. A shorter clipped fraction is not necessarily biologically more accurate.
soft_clipped_bases_per_1000_read_bases.label: Clipped bases per 1,000 mapped read bases

soft_clipped_reads.denominator: Count; mapped primary alignment records are the reference population.
soft_clipped_reads.description: Primary mapped alignment records with at least one CIGAR S operation. Both ends of the same read count once here.
soft_clipped_reads.label: Soft-clipped primary reads

stitched_contig_count.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: stitched_contigs.csv rows; fewer is only a runtime burden proxy. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
stitched_contig_count.description: Stitched contig count: stitched_contigs.csv rows; fewer is only a runtime burden proxy. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
stitched_contig_count.label: Stitched contig count

supplementary.denominator: Count of SAM supplementary alignment records.
supplementary.description: SAM supplementary alignments, often associated with split mappings. Whether more or fewer is desirable depends on the sample.
supplementary.label: Supplementary alignments

total_read_depth.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: sum of coverage across genome_coverage.csv rows. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
total_read_depth.description: Total read depth: sum of coverage across genome_coverage.csv rows. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
total_read_depth.label: Total read depth

unique_aligned_fragments.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: distinct original QNAME pairs with accepted Q15 merged placement. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
unique_aligned_fragments.description: Unique aligned fragments: distinct original QNAME pairs with accepted Q15 merged placement. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
unique_aligned_fragments.label: Unique aligned fragments

unstitched_contig_count.denominator: Original MiCall measurement rule: unstitched_contigs.csv rows; fewer is only a runtime burden proxy. No imputed values when source artifacts are absent.
unstitched_contig_count.description: Unstitched contig count: unstitched_contigs.csv rows; fewer is only a runtime burden proxy. Reported by the named MiCall output stage only when a valid source file is retained.
unstitched_contig_count.label: Unstitched contig count
